display_long_description:
Make your spray painting training step into the future, with the Skillveri Spray Painting Simulator Enterprise edition.

A fully immersive training experience in advanced Mixed Reality which seamlessly blends virtual workpieces with your real surroundings. Enable your learners to practice repeatedly with no paint waste. 

The Skillveri Spray Painting simulator Enterprise edition includes - 
Choice of Airspray, Airless and Electrostatic painting processes.
Real spray gun integration for each process. 
Choose from different industry modules - automotive OEM, auto refinish, construction and protective coatings.
Primer, base, and top coats just as in real life.,
Adjust fan size and nozzle
Progressive learning from easy to complex workpieces
Each workpiece with lessons for speed, distance, and angle 
Feedback & no feedback modes. Practice with guidance while learning and choose the no feedback mode to assess yourself.
Score cards, movement graphs,and thickness maps for performance analysis.
Casting app to monitor and guide multiple learners.
Detailed reporting dashboard for trainers.

To enable our painting simulator for your institution’s CTE or workforce training, write to us at usa@skillveri.com. Skillveri simulators are used by global industries and across 100+ schools and colleges across the USA in their CTE programs. Check out www.skillveri.com for more details. 
For personal usage, check out our Automotive SprayPainting Sim-Personal and Home SprayPainting Simulator-Personal
